kol.via_en: Dwarkesh Podcast — "We are near the end of the exponential"
kol.take: 数据中心采购节奏 vs 收入增速的时点风险——「错两年就是毁灭性的」；重申 2026-27 出现「数据中心里的天才国度」；Claude Code 已成 enterprise 主导 → coding agent 是 token 消耗的结构性主力
kol.take_en: On datacenter buildout vs revenue timing — "being off by a couple of years could be ruinous"; reiterates "a country of geniuses in a datacenter" by 2026-27; Claude Code now dominant in enterprise → coding agents are the structural driver of token consumption

kol.take: AI 正在成为数字工作的新 operating layer：从 vibe coding 进入 agentic engineering，人类的角色变成指挥、监督与编排 agents
kol.take_en: AI is becoming the new operating layer for digital work: from vibe coding to agentic engineering — humans direct, supervise and orchestrate agents

kol.take: 「loopy era」：自主系统自己跑实验、训模型、调参；自 2025-12 起基本不再手写代码——对 token 结构的含义：agent 长任务 = 输出 token 与工具调用密度双升
kol.take_en: The "loopy era": autonomous systems run their own experiments, training and tuning; he has barely hand-written code since Dec 2025 — implication for token mix: long agent tasks push both output tokens and tool-call density up
